subject: ddl: use static contexts in `NewReorgCopContext` (#55823)
summary: Reviewed this commit vs first parent focusing on DDL add-index reorg/cop context behavior. `NewReorgCopContext` now builds static Expr/DistSQL contexts from `DDLReorgMeta` (SQL mode/timezone/type flags/err levels/resource group) and derives pushdown flags from those; mock DistSQL context resource group and stmt mem/disk tracker wiring are aligned.
